method: Best of seven rotating interleaved process wall times, including startup and I/O; every output verified; two-second timeout and unlimited process stack, matching upstream. All samples and medians retained. A full scan selected the top three per workload plus all six ASM evaluators for a fresh final comparison.

not_tested: DAG server/canonicalizer and other implementations outside benchmark/run-one.sh roster
scope.cpp_build_note: GCC 12.2 and Clang 14 with libstdc++, instead of upstream Clang/libc++/C++23. Omitted only LazyAppStream include/registry entry (already excluded from official suite) because this host lacks append_range; evaluator sources unchanged.
